headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.4
summary: Switching the storage location of an instance in Content Management now offers to move the instance's game data along: worlds, packs, and settings follow to the new location instead of being left behind.

items.text: Changing the storage location in Content Management can now move your instance's game data to the new location, with a confirmation before anything is moved.
Moves are verified before the old copy is removed, and on failure the launcher reverts the change and keeps your data safe at the original location.
